description: 480p lightweight pair for logic tests. Same semantics as lg-daylight-auto-align but downscaled — L2 drains ~100 ms instead of ~1.3 s, so tests can iterate quickly without changing behavior (scoring is on normalized 64x64 fingerprints regardless of source resolution). The 2160p pair is reserved for resolution-mismatch and performance-regression coverage.

check_points.rationale: First aligned frame: left raw=0 matches right raw=2069000us.
